$comment: The components and hooks of this package the React Compiler leaves uncompiled: its bailouts (it could not prove the Rules of React; the reason is its own) and the functions it cannot see as components (notCompiled). Written by tooling/js/react-compiler-coverage.mjs --write; CI fails on a new one, and the lists only get shorter (apps/editor/docs/adr/228-react-compiler.md).
